scientific_integrity.computations: Finite, reproducible direct-definition and independent center-expansion tests accompany the proof; they are not infinite proofs.
scientific_integrity.prior_work: Simpson's six-run near-extremal construction is expressly credited and is not claimed as original.
scientific_integrity.proof: Self-contained infinite-parameter run enumeration and parity argument are included in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: The all-length exact identity concerns four-run binary circular words; the broader bound concerns at most four runs.
The known six-run construction demonstrates the necessity of at least six runs to exceed the three-halves level, but does not classify all six-run circles.
The unrestricted circular-palindrome maximum remains undetermined by these results.
The closest full primary manuscript was unavailable for complete comparison, and historical priority is not independently settled.
title: A sharp four-run barrier for palindromes in binary circular words
